purpose: Authored coordination metadata only; not a runtime asset loader or a game-map/graphics extract.

scope.current: Tristram exterior and town-visible runtime categories
scope.conditionalContent: Hellfire entries are source-identified reservation stubs, not audited asset coverage.

contract.nullableCounts: null means not verified or state-dependent; variantCount excludes animation frames, camera directions and random procedural seeds.
contract.claimFields: claimIssue is a project GitHub issue URL; claimOwner is its assigned GitHub login. Both remain null until a maintainer confirms the reservation. Issue assignment/labels are the live queue; registry updates record it.
contract.acceptance: accepted requires reviewer, approvedRevision, provenance (kind/license/source), an existing assetPath for authored models and native-angle forced-mesh / 360 / simulation evidence. Home backend reuse is not mesh proof.

milestones.gate: Identify residual scenery, finish the complete retail/shareware Tristram objects and required states, then accept their visual and gameplay checks.
After Tristram, make the first procedural Cathedral level work from the existing live map and seed, preserving collision/triggers and validating whole geometry.
Only after the first procedural Cathedral level works, expand the catalog for further Diablo/Hellfire levels and tested edition variants.

native-360-collision: Compare forced geometry to the real native backend at calibrated camera; Home is a dispatch check only.
Inspect whole silhouette and ±5-degree transitions plus eight azimuths; no missing backs/undersides, door/window projection on wrong faces or hidden native-visible actors.
Verify dimensions, ground contact, finite nondegenerate outward geometry, appropriate closure, picking and occlusion.
Keep the live map, SOL/collision, player/NPC positions, triggers and random seed unchanged; reload deterministically.
actor-animation-360: Use the same real frame across source directions; inspect face/back, limbs, clothing and attached props through 360 degrees.
Feet contact native ground; shadows stay on ground; no duplicated anatomy or plane-thin side views.
Check idle/walk/actions and planned armor/weapon variants; preserve native actor positions, selection and interaction.
Label inferred anatomy and supply lawful authored-art provenance.
terrain-continuity-collision: Compare native-scale floor continuity without cracks or invented semantic material IDs.
Verify banks/crossings and state transitions with native traversal/collision; ground pieces are not object instances.
Preserve original map/seed and actor ground contact under orbit/pan/zoom.
identify-before-model: Find and document a whole native source stencil and its material/instance variants without committing proprietary extracts.
Check overlap with existing architecture/tree/rock source membership and claim issues.
A maintainer creates a specific stable ID before artistic modeling starts.
items-effects-runtime: Compare the same active item/effect and animation frame with native rendering.
Inspect transparency, attachment/ground placement, 360 visibility and selection/trigger behavior where applicable.
Preserve live inventory, missile simulation and actor picking; distinguish decals, billboards and actual volumes.

verifiedSnapshot.method: Curated aggregate values from the local v4-final retail/shareware smoke summaries; proprietary captures/map dumps are excluded.
verifiedSnapshot.caveat: Counts describe this recorded state and full renderer grid, not an exhaustive Diablo/Hellfire asset count. Older cropped diagnostics reported 419 rocks; use 501 for this snapshot.

entries.name: Native town ground layer
notes: The native floor is rendered as a ground layer; it is not one object per SOL tile. Piece 0 is valid.
Grass, dirt, paths, bank and water material families need a separate verified semantic inventory. No exhaustive material IDs or authored variant count are claimed.

entries.name: River banks, water and crossings
notes: Reserve discovery/classification first. Riverside trees are separately cataloged; water/bank/bridge geometry and any animation states require verified source grouping. Do not alter native traversal or reseed the map.

entries.name: Fences, loose walls and railings
notes: No exact fence or standalone wall stencils are verified by the current whole-object groupers.

entries.name: Dropped-item visual families

entries.name: Town missiles, spells and portal effects
notes: The current free-camera path draws missile frames as billboards. No complete volumetric or VFX library is accepted.

entries.name: Actor ground shadows and future scene shadows
notes: Native painted actor shadows are separated into ground decals. They are not geometry-cast dynamic shadows.
